newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to buy up to 76,000/T Jan fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to buy up to 76,000/T Jan fuel oil.

text.p: State-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy up to 76,000 tonnes of high pour low sulphur fuel oil for delivery January 1-30, a company official said on Monday.
The tender seeks up to two cargoes of 38,000 tonnes each of 0.5 percent sulphur fuel oil for delivery to Kaohsiung.
The tender closes December 18 and is valid until December 20, the official said.
CPC's last purchase of a 38,000 tonne cargo of low sulphur fuel oil was at $143 per tonne for delivery between January 1-20.
